race.comment: LUNA BALLET (7) has contested much better maidens than this. Wasn't beaten that far at Belmont before a spell. Should be pushing forward quickly here and off a good trial, prove hard to beat off those city form lines. ENCHANTED LASS (6) heads over from Victoria with some decent form at the Provincials there. If she can take up a position, she is a hope. MARKET PLAYER (3) has been in the betting a few times despite his record. Gets some important gear changes too. REIGN IN THE CASH (1) came good at the end of last campaign. Should be getting a good run in transit the whole way. DESERT MADAME (8) had some support when last in work. Just needs to make good improvement this time around.
